objective: Produce version-locked, provenance-aware semantic packets and compilation contracts from which DSH can implement a deterministic high-fidelity HSR 4.4.54 combat simulator. This is broader than the frozen standard-MVP packet set.
non_goal: Binary-identical client reconstruction, client UI/animation/performance reproduction, or a claim that external static data by itself proves native runtime order.

evidence_policy.local_reverse_policy: DEFERRED_BY_THIS_PROGRAM; existing local artifacts may be cited but no new unpack/native work is a prerequisite for a reconstructed packet.
evidence_policy.version_rule: 4.4.54 values remain isolated. CLOSE-version sources may supply schema, algorithms, or candidates only and must never silently overwrite exact-version data.

completion_standard.full_simulation_reconstruction: Every supported 4.4.54 content behavior compiles to an explicit deterministic effect graph; all global state transitions, target/action legality, timeline/event order, mode rules, and terminal rules used by that graph have a versioned packet and golden scenarios.
completion_standard.per_behavior_exit: ID-preserved source record -> canonical behavior record -> compiled IR/effect graph -> deterministic golden trace. Unsupported or ambiguous behavior is explicit and blocks the relevant coverage denominator rather than being silently approximated.
completion_standard.dsh_ready: The DSH handoff contains stable schemas, a compiler contract, semantic packets, external/canonical provenance, coverage ledger, golden traces, and a bounded unsupported list. DSH does not have to infer a gameplay rule from prose or from a third-party JSON file.

workstreams.name: Program control and reproducibility
workstreams.start_condition: This program and the 4.4.54 canonical database exist.
workstreams.finish_condition: Every packet, source capture, compiler output, trace and coverage numerator has a stable ID, source hash/version, owner, and deterministic rebuild command.
workstreams.dsh_output: Version manifest, provenance schema, coverage ledger, compatibility gate.

workstreams.name: External behavior corpus capture
workstreams.start_condition: Pinned source commit and declared retrieval profile are available.
workstreams.finish_condition: Required source families are captured at low concurrency from explicit pinned paths; raw files, hashes, schema observations and exact/close-version status are recorded. No unbounded repository mirror is required.

workstreams.name: Canonical effect and behavior IR

workstreams.finish_condition: A stable, ID-preserving behavior model represents effect phases, target intent, formulas, conditions, modifiers, action/timeline operations, event subscriptions, and opaque fallback fields without source-schema leakage.
workstreams.dsh_output: Canonical schemas and compiler input contracts.

workstreams.name: Global deterministic battle kernel specification
workstreams.start_condition: Dynamic MVP packets are imported as the ordinary-action base.
workstreams.finish_condition: State model, event queue/order, action legality, resources, AV, damage/heal/shield, death/revive, modifiers, break, extra-action and follow-up scheduling have packet-level contracts and interaction golden tests.

workstreams.name: Content-family compiler coverage

workstreams.name: Scenario assembly, encounter, and mode reconstruction

Wave spawning, enemy action policy, boss phases, standard/MoC/PF/AS/Simulated-Universe-like mode rules and stage buff activation each have explicit supported scopes and trace fixtures.

workstreams.name: Differential verification and planner-ready interface

handoff_protocol.stop_safely_when: Before a context/token budget cannot finish a coherent ticket, write the current evidence, rejected models, exact next distinguishing question and no-op rebuild/test commands to the coverage ledger; never leave knowledge only in chat.

identity/static coverage counted as behavior coverage
